metadata.label: Water abstraction in industry by NACE division and type of water. Year 2005-2020
note:
This table contains statistics on water abstraction in industry disaggregated by NACE division and type of water. Industry is defined as companies within section B, C and D (Mining and quarrying, Manufacturing and Electricity, gas, steam and air conditioning supply) in the NACE framework. Type of water denotes source of water, e.g. groundwater, surface water, sea water or water purchased from other water supplier. Note that water abstraction from nuclear power plants is not included in the table. Volumes of abstracted water can differ from volumes of used water. For data on water use, please use the table: Water use in industry by region and type of water.
The statistics refer to water abstraction during the entire year of reference.

label.07-09: mining of metal ores, other mining and quarrying, mining support service activities and service
label.10-12: food product, beverage and tobacco industry
label.16: industry for wood and products of wood, cork, cane etc. , except furniture
label.17: industry for paper and paper products
label.18: printers; other industry for recorded media
label.19: manufacture of coke and refined petroleum products
label.20-21: industry for chemical, chemical products and pharmaceutical products
label.22-23: industry for rubber and plastic products and other non-metallic mineral products
label.24-25: industry for basic metals and fabricated metal products, except machinery and equipment
label.26-27: industry for computer, electronic and optical products, electrical equipment
label.28: industry for machinery and equipment n.e.c.
label.33: repair shops and installation companies for machinery and equipment
label.35: electricity, gas, steam and hot water plants

label.20: purchased potable water and reused water
label.40: groundwater from own source including drainage water

10: Purchased potable water delivered from public or other water supplier.
20: Purchased potable water and treated or untreated water used by other economic unit before delivery.
30: Freshwater recovered, from an underground formation, by means of self-supply (excluding drainage water).
40: Freshwater recovered from, an underground formation, by means of self-supply and drainage water from mines and quarries. Before 2015, drainage water was not included in the data collection. For time series analysis on groundwater abstraction, please use “Groundwater from own source”.
50: Freshwater recovered from lakes or other water courses by means of self-supply.
60: Sea water (salt or brackish water) recovered from the sea by means of self-supply. Sea water is surface water with a mass salinity higher than around 0,5 per mille.
70: Water with unknown source (ground water, surface water or sea water).
80: Total volume of freshwater purchased and abstracted by means of self-supply. Freshwater is surface water and groundwater with a mass salinity less than around 0,5 per mille.
90: Total volume of freshwater and seawater purchased and abstracted by means of self-supply.
